utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good morning, Gus. I've marked Saturday at 9 for the repair drive on my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Eli! I'll be there with my toolbox. See you then!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect, Gus. I'll see you Saturday morning. It'll be good to get that project moving.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh good, Jules! I almost forgot—Tess told me it's on Sunday now, not Saturday. Glad you reminded me.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Wait, Tess told me it's Saturday! I'd better double-check with her.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh no, are we mixed up again? I thought Tess said Sunday, but maybe I heard wrong.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, I see—so the time isn't set yet? Let me know if you need any help sorting out the tools or contacting folks.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's so kind of you, Hana. I might take you up on that—could you help me call the community center to confirm their availability? I'll handle the tool list.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure, I can do that. Do you have the community center's phone number handy?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Mara, have you heard anything about the repair drive? I've been getting bits and pieces from neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, I've been lining up volunteers. Opal and Leo have both said yes, so we're in good shape for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That's great to hear! Is there anything specific you still need help with?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Ira, you joining the playground repair drive Saturday at 9?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I'll be there! I'm actually planning to pick up a flyer later to see what tools they need.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, cool. Don't worry about the flyer, just bring basic tools like a hammer and screwdriver.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Quinn, I'm checking my supply list for Saturday. Need me to bring anything extra?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Cleo! Maybe bring some extra tools like hammers or screwdrivers. I'm heading to the park to recruit more people, see you Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it, I'll pack extra hammers and screwdrivers. See you Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Dane! Just wanted to let you know that the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center, from 9 to 3. Hope to see you there!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, thanks Rosa! I thought it was 10, so 9 works even better. I'll bring my blender for sure.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Dane! Can't wait to see your blender in action. See you Sunday at 9!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I'm a bit confused about the time now—Faye said 9 AM, you said 10 AM, and Kira mentioned Pia's concerns about traffic. Maybe we should double-check with Pia?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, maybe check with Pia, but I'm pretty sure it's 10 AM at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Alright, I'll try to catch Pia later today to confirm. Better to have it straight.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Uli, the repair drive is now on Sunday at 10 AM, still at the community center. Can you let others know?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, I thought it was from 9 to 3? Let me check with Rosa again.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I'm pretty sure it's 10 AM, not 9 to 3. Let's confirm with the organizers to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, you're right, Rey. Vik straightened me out—it's definitely at 10 AM. I'll see you there with the maps!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, 10 AM it is. Glad that's cleared up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, I'll have all the station maps ready and labeled by then.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Leo! Are you planning to join the repair drive this Saturday? We're starting at 9 AM at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I'll be there at 9.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, Leo! Do you have any tools you can bring? We have a list of needed items if you need ideas.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: But did anyone actually confirm with Pia about the traffic? She specifically said it could be a problem.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I haven't talked to Pia myself, but I know the drive is now Sunday at the community center—maybe traffic won't be as bad there?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sunday? Are you sure about that? I thought I heard it was Saturday. Did Pia confirm the change?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Rey, are you planning to join the repair drive this Saturday? I'm gathering supplies.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I was thinking of heading over. I can bring my toolbox if you need anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, a toolbox would be great, Gus! I think we could use some wrenches and screwdrivers for the playground equipment.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Leo, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, I'll be there at 9 AM with my tools.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, see you there! I'll grab a flyer for you too—lots of details on what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, got it! I must have mixed up the times. I'll see you at the community center at 10 AM then.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Actually Opal, we're starting at 9 AM, not 10. Hope you can make it at 9!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Wait, Vik said 10 AM. Are you sure it's 9? I don't want to show up at the wrong time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Mina, are you planning to go to the repair drive this Sunday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, I'll be there. Still at 10 AM, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it's actually from 9 to 3, Mina! I think it starts at 9, not 10.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Okay, lead the way.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Alright, let's go! We'll see what needs fixing at the park and get some folks on board.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: So, do you know who we should talk to first about the repairs?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Oren, did you hear the repair drive is Sunday at 10? I'm bringing my blender.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, is it 10? I thought Tess said it starts at 9. Well, I'll be there anyway with my hammer.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Huh, I heard 10 from Mina. Maybe we should double-check.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Noah, have you heard about the repair drive? I'm thinking of joining but I'd like to know more about what tools they need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: The repair drive? Oh, right, that thing with the playground... tools, huh? I think Vik mentioned something about bringing your own, but I'm not sure. Maybe ask Kira?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Good idea, I'll check with Kira. Thanks, Noah!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Kira, you in for the playground repair drive Saturday at 9?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, did you check with Pia about the traffic? She mentioned it could be an issue if we pick a busy time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, I didn't think about that. Saturday morning should be quiet though, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, so the time isn't set yet? I was planning for Saturday at 10. Let me know when it's confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, there's been some mix-up. I heard 9 from Faye but Vik said 10, and Kira mentioned Pia had concerns about traffic. Maybe we should check with Pia to confirm.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Good idea, Sam. Let's ask Pia directly to get the correct time before we commit.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara! Are you planning to come to the repair drive this Saturday at 10? Tess is bringing her toaster, and it should be a fun time!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Jules! I thought it was at 9, but I'll definitely be there. Can't wait to see Tess's toaster!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Glad you can make it! Yeah, it's 10 AM at the community center—Bo and Pia will be there too. See you Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, thanks for letting me know, Rosa. Sunday at the community center works for me. I'll adjust my plans.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Wait, Uli—Sunday? I thought we were aiming for Saturday at 10 AM. I still need to confirm with the community center and check on tools.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That's odd... Rosa just told me it's Sunday. Did you hear differently from someone else?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Vik! Just so you know, the repair drive has been moved to Sunday instead of Saturday, same time and place.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Wait, Sunday? But I told everyone Saturday at 10. Are you sure? I'll have to let Sam and Opal know.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I'm sorry about the confusion, Vik! Yes, it's definitely Sunday now. I can help you reach out to Sam and Opal if you'd like.
